verses.1: And even if the Egyptians enslaved the children of Israel with harsh labor and with grievous work, and with all the work which they made them do, and with burdens without number.
verses.2: And they set over them taskmasters and made them serve; and they cried out to God, that He might save them from all the oppression of the Egyptians.
verses.3: And at that time He sent them their helper, Moses and Aaron, and delivered them from the grievous labor, for God sent them to bring His people out of the house of bondage of Pharaoh, king of Egypt, for in his pride he had greatly oppressed the people, so that they could not gather together nor offer sacrifice to God in the wilderness.
verses.4: For God humbles the proud, and because of the pride of Pharaoh, God cast him and his armies into the Red Sea.
verses.5: And likewise those who humble themselves before the word of God, while kings and rulers do not act rightly in all that He appointed them and made them kings to do His will, He will give their power to those who serve in goodness and glorify His great name.
verses.6: And if they have made their kingdom upright, I also will establish their kingdom, says God, who rules over all.
verses.7: Do good to Me, and I also will do good to you; keep My commandments, and I also will keep your souls; walk in My commandments, and I also will walk according to your heart.
verses.8: Love Me, and I also will love your life; take refuge with Me, and I also will carry you away to safety.
verses.9: And trust in Me, and I also will save you, says God, who rules over all.
verses.10: Do not go far away; draw near to Me, and I will draw you near, for I love upright ways, says God, who rules over all. Wash your hands, O sinners, and purify yourselves, and remove the evil of your hearts.
verses.11: And I also will remove My wrath from you, and I will have compassion on you with mercy and lovingkindness.
verses.12: And I will remove from you the oppression of the wicked who do violence, as I saved David My servant from many afflictions which befell him: from the hand of Goliath the Philistine, and from the hand of Saul who sought to kill him, and from the hand of Absalom his son who sought to take his kingdom.
verses.13: And likewise I will save those who do My will and keep My commandments and walk in My law, and I will give them glory as an inheritance and make them reign over all, that they may rejoice in this world and in the world to come.
verses.14: And they shall be companions with the blessed kings who pleased God by the goodness of their lives, like Samuel, while he was yet a child, whom God chose from his youth for the goodness of his life.
verses.15: And He spoke with him, that he might speak to Eli the aged priest; and good was the conduct of Samuel the prophet, while he ministered in the house of God the Lord.
verses.16: And when he grew up in the house of God, while he ministered, he appointed rulers over the people and anointed kings at the command of God. And he poured the anointing oil of kingship with his own hand when he did the will of God his Lord, for He had chosen him before him to rule the people whom God had chosen from the children of Israel.
verses.17: And while Saul was still in the kingdom, God said to Samuel the prophet: Go, anoint David the son of Jesse, who is of the house of Judah, for I have chosen him.
